headline: An account that could change the way Croats invest money. Banks are already rubbing their hands
summary: The consultation on the draft law on the Croatian Investment Account ran from 24 July to 23 August. The draft is published on the Hanfa e-savjetovanje portal.
why: The Croatian Financial Services Supervisory Agency (Hanfa) regulates non-bank financial markets, and a new investment account would change how households invest and how banks compete for those savings.
